verdict.rationale: The docs describe general liveness via head-turn/motion capture and facial similarity/known-faces matching, but nowhere name specific defenses against AI-generated faces, deepfakes, or camera-injection attacks — only generic 'liveness' and fraud-repeat detection are mentioned. missing for 10: named deepfake detection, AI-generated face detection, camera/virtual-camera injection defenses, or any anti-spoofing technique beyond basic head-movement liveness.
